baseline.reproduction: Restore the separately frozen frontend captured from commit 86804e7 before the q95 conversion and pass its directory with --baseline-root; do not reuse the already converted candidate as the baseline.

methodology.database: One shared temporary SQLite fixture, migrated/seeded; connect measured before browsing
methodology.origins: two loopback listeners on ephemeral ports; API CORS allows exactly both
methodology.browserProxy: --no-proxy-server only for this temporary Chrome and loopback harness; system settings unchanged
methodology.constrainedProfile: 10Mbps down,5Mbps up,40ms latency; no CPU throttle
methodology.lcp: Last observed candidate, not field p75; active API only, no click/focus/input.
methodology.menuReady: MutationObserver sees data-session-role written by layout; functional clicks tested separately
methodology.bytes: sum of CDP Network.loadingFinished.encodedDataLength for allowed origins, including document; pending/failed responses are incomplete, not total traffic
methodology.requestCount: allowed-origin CDP requests, including document; external blocked requests counted separately
methodology.scope: Local static-host model, not Cloudflare CDN/TLS/cache performance or measured Render cold start

comparisonBoundary.baselineRole: Existing Pages-ready integrated frontend with lossless WebP, frozen byte-exact before q95 conversion
comparisonBoundary.coupledLabel: Harness name for the frozen baseline delivered from the API loopback origin
comparisonBoundary.pagesLabel: Harness name for q95 candidate delivered from the separate static loopback origin
comparisonBoundary.limit: Local origin topology differs; this is not a measurement of Cloudflare/Render providers or field p75. Only active API scenarios were executed.

evidencePreservation.sanitization: Replaced absolute local TEMP/workspace roots with placeholders. Original resource pathnames, timings, hashes and safe metadata retained; no bodies, query values or credentials.
evidencePreservation.rawTracesAndScreenshots: Remain in TEMP; only metadata and SHA-256 references are included when present.
